Technology description including backgro: Jumpax® Classic is a two-layer underlay system with interactive bonding and a levelling layer laminated underneath for easy levelling of sharp unevenness up to 3 mm. A quick and perfect subfloor for sophisticated design coverings or even hard-wearing linoleum qualities. Jumpax® Classic is the most powerful underlay in the field of impact sound reducing and balancing systems. By installing Jumpax® Classic, any subfloor is transformed into an absolutely even subfloor in no time at all, on which design flooring, CV coverings, linoleum, cork and carpet can be glued directly. This can save an enormous amount of time and money and complicated and time-consuming activities for levelling a subfloor are a thing of the past. Jumpax® Classic has been tested by recognised institutes for impact sound reduction and shows an improvement of 25 dB ΔLw in the system with a design floor. The basis is the European standard EN ISO 140-8 / 717-2 in combination with floor coverings on concrete floors with screed. Jumpax® Classic is manufactured by Unifloor 50% at Hephata in Mönchengladbach in Germany (Künkelstraße 43, 41063 Mönchengladbach) and 50% at De Bolder in Texel in the Netherlands (Rei-jer Keijserstraat 8, 1791 AX Den Burg - Texel). Here, the individual layers (MDF etc.) are joined together with glue and then packed for transport to the place of use. | |
